diff:
--- a/config.py
+++ b/config.py
@@ -1,4 +1,19 @@
+import copy
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+
 def merge_config(defaults, overrides):
-    result = dict(defaults)
-    result.update(overrides)
+    result = {}
+    for key, value in defaults.items():
+        if key in overrides:
+            override_value = overrides[key]
+            if isinstance(value, Mapping) and isinstance(override_value, Mapping):
+                result[key] = merge_config(value, override_value)
+            else:
+                result[key] = copy.deepcopy(override_value)
+        else:
+            result[key] = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    for key, value in overrides.items():
+        if key not in defaults:
+            result[key] = copy.deepcopy(value)
     return result
--- a/tests/test_merge_config_regression.py
+++ b/tests/test_merge_config_regression.py
@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+from config import merge_config
+
+
+def test_returns_all_keys_from_base_and_overrides():
+    result = merge_config({"a": 1, "b": 2}, {"b": 3, "c": 4})
+    assert result == {"a": 1, "b": 3, "c": 4}
+    assert isinstance(result, dict)
+
+
+def test_recursive_merge_of_nested_mappings():
+    base = {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 5432}}
+    overrides = {"db": {"port": 6543, "user": "admin"}}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert result == {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 6543, "user": "admin"}}
+    assert isinstance(result["db"], dict)
+
+
+def test_override_wins_at_leaf():
+    result = merge_config({"a": {"b": 1}}, {"a": {"b": 2}})
+    assert result["a"]["b"] == 2
+
+
+def test_keys_only_in_overrides_included():
+    result = merge_config({"a": 1}, {"b": 2})
+    assert result == {"a": 1, "b": 2}
+
+
+def test_keys_only_in_base_preserved():
+    result = merge_config({"a": 1, "b": 2}, {"c": 3})
+    assert result == {"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}
+
+
+def test_lists_are_replaced_not_concatenated():
+    base = {"items": [1, 2, 3]}
+    overrides = {"items": [4, 5]}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert result["items"] == [4, 5]
+    assert isinstance(result["items"], list)
+
+
+def test_lists_replaced_in_nested_mappings():
+    base = {"a": {"items": [1, 2]}}
+    overrides = {"a": {"items": [3]}}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert result["a"]["items"] == [3]
+
+
+def test_does_not_mutate_base():
+    base = {"a": {"b": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"a": {"b": 2}, "items": [3]}
+    base_snapshot = {"a": {"b": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert base == base_snapshot
+
+
+def test_does_not_mutate_overrides():
+    base = {"a": {"b": 1}}
+    overrides = {"a": {"b": 2}, "items": [3]}
+    overrides_snapshot = {"a": {"b": 2}, "items": [3]}
+    merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert overrides == overrides_snapshot
+
+
+def test_result_shares_no_nested_objects_with_inputs():
+    base = {"a": {"b": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"a": {"c": 2}, "items": [3]}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert result["a"] is not base["a"]
+    assert result["a"] is not overrides["a"]
+    assert result["items"] is not base["items"]
+    assert result["items"] is not overrides["items"]
+
+
+def test_mutating_result_does_not_affect_inputs():
+    base = {"a": {"b": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"a": {"c": 2}, "items": [3]}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    result["a"]["b"] = 999
+    result["items"].append(4)
+    assert base == {"a": {"b": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    assert overrides == {"a": {"c": 2}, "items": [3]}
+
+
+def test_mutating_inputs_does_not_affect_result():
+    base = {"a": {"b": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"a": {"c": 2}, "items": [3]}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    base["a"]["b"] = 999
+    base["items"].append(4)
+    overrides["a"]["c"] = 888
+    overrides["items"].append(5)
+    assert result == {"a": {"b": 1, "c": 2}, "items": [3]}
+
+
+def test_simple_overrides_still_work():
+    assert merge_config({"a": 1}, {"a": 2, "b": 3}) == {"a": 2, "b": 3}
+    assert merge_config({}, {}) == {}

contract_tests: test_recursive_merge_of_nested_mappings: merge_config({"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 5432}}, {"db": {"port": 6543, "user": "admin"}}) == {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 6543, "user": "admin"}} with nested dict type.
test_does_not_mutate_base: base unchanged after merge_config(base, overrides).
test_does_not_mutate_overrides: overrides unchanged after merge_config(base, overrides).
test_result_shares_no_nested_objects_with_inputs: result["a"] is not base["a"], result["a"] is not overrides["a"], result["items"] is not base["items"], result["items"] is not overrides["items"].
test_mutating_result_does_not_affect_inputs: mutating result nested dict/list leaves base and overrides unchanged.
test_mutating_inputs_does_not_affect_result: mutating base/overrides after call leaves result == {"a": {"b": 1, "c": 2}, "items": [3]}.

edits.old:
def merge_config(defaults, overrides):
    result = dict(defaults)
    result.update(overrides)
    return result

patches.rationale: Rewrite merge_config to recursively merge nested mappings, replace lists wholesale, and return fully independent data (deep-copied leaves) without mutating or aliasing either input. Add a new regression test file covering all acceptance contracts.
